Hi Alex - great to meet you over email. Sorry about the Calendly confusion - we've seen a couple of customers hit this when their browser locale or Calendly cookie defaults to a different timezone. There's also a DST change at the end of the month (UK moves to BST on Sun Mar 29) which can make things look inconsistent in some widgets.

Two quick options to unblock:
1) Try this Calendly link which forces Europe/London timezone: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo?timezone=Europe%2FLondon
2) If it still shows wrong times, reply with a preferred slot and we'll send a calendar invite manually (I'll CC Marissa to help).

Wed 31 Mar 14:00 GMT works for us - I just want to confirm whether you mean 14:00 GMT (which is 15:00 BST after the switch) - given the DST change next Sunday. If you're in London on the 31st, 14:00 GMT is effectively 15:00 local if clocks have gone forward.

If you prefer, we can alternatively do 14:00 GMT / 10:00 ET (US) - please confirm which timezone you want the invite to show.

I'll hold 31 Mar 14:00 GMT on my calendar pending your confirmation.

Best,
